claims.claim: Nikon Z fc, 20.9MP APS-C retro mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show 'Nikon' and 'Zfc' engraved on body top plate, consistent with described model.
No photo of a shutter-count readout (camera menu screen or software like ShutterCount) is present.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No close-up of the lens glass (front/rear element against light) is shown, only the exterior barrel marking.
Photo 2 shows a Nikon-branded rechargeable battery and matching Nikon charger.
No internal shots, screws, or seal-tamper indicators are visible to confirm repair history.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be higher than claimed, affecting mechanical wear.
risks.proof: Screenshot of in-camera menu or third-party shutter-count tool showing actuation number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-use/unknown shutter count (worst case).

risks.risk: Lens glass may have scratches, fungus, or dust affecting image quality.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements against a light source.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if lens has optical defects.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, dead pixels) not verifiable.
risks.proof: Photo of sensor with lens removed, plus a test shot against plain sky.
risks.if_unproven: Price as sensor condition unknown/worst case.

risks.risk: Screen, EVF, dials, and buttons functional status unknown.
risks.proof: Short video clip powering on camera, operating dials, and showing live view/EVF.
risks.if_unproven: Price as functionally unverified (treat as needing repair).

risks.risk: Battery health/cycle count and charger authenticity unverified.
risks.proof: Photo of battery info screen showing charge cycles, and close-up of charger model/serial for authenticity check.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming degraded battery and non-verified charger.

risks.risk: Whether only the TTArtisan lens is included or also a native kit lens.
risks.proof: Photo confirming all lenses/accessories included in the sale, matched against seller's listed items.
risks.if_unproven: Price for body + TTArtisan lens only, no kit lens assumed.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents, corrosion) on angles not shown (bottom, sides, mount contacts).
risks.proof: Photos of all sides including base plate and lens mount contacts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetic condition unverified/worst case.

risks.risk: No memory card, strap, or USB cable confirmed present.
risks.proof: Photo showing these accessories alongside the camera.

proof_requests: Screenshot or video of shutter actuation count from camera menu or software.
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements under light to check for fungus/scratches.
Short video of camera powering on, dial operation, and live view/EVF display.
Photo of sensor with lens removed.
Photos of all external sides including base and lens mount contacts.
Battery info screen showing charge cycle count.
Confirmation photo of all included accessories (cables, strap, memory card, box).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Nikon Z fc with TTArtisan lens and accessories, so it can be priced; all seller claims about condition, shutter count, and repair history are unverifiable remotely and must be priced at worst case until proof is provided.
